method: Whole-file manual reading of six UI command/converter/hover implementation files; exact-commit downloads matched pinned Git blob IDs.
findings: RelayCommand delegates Execute without rechecking CanExecute or catching exceptions; callers own admission/error handling. CanExecuteChanged forwards WPF global requery event.

Base64ImageConverter decodes entire string without byte/pixel admission limits; data-URL failure falls back to treating original string as URI. Embedded images use OnLoad+Freeze, URI-loaded images do not; runtime loading/thread behavior unqualified.
Enum description converter returns text for undefined values and ConvertBack returns input unchanged; display text is not enum-domain validation.

HoverBackground installs anonymous Loaded handler without removing it on disable; disable restores only nonnull original brush, so originally null background may retain hover brush. Direct property assignment can replace existing bindings.

HoverBorder disable only detaches handlers and does not restore active hover border/thickness. HoverBrightness disable likewise leaves current adorner until another removal path; no unload cleanup here.

Brightness visual-tree search checks immediate children then recursively visits subtrees, not a globally breadth-first traversal; deep templates can consume recursive stack. Opacity and animation-duration attached values have no explicit validation/coercion in these helpers.
limits: No WPF rendering, image decoder admission/runtime, binding or hover lifecycle tests executed. No foreign production code adopted.
